<!-- overview:start -->

## Overview

Discover bundled Node.js actions and validate each checked-in distribution on a
host runner and in a Node.js container. Requires contents: read only.

Packages at the root or under actions/ are discovered when they declare build
and check:dist scripts. Override working-directories with newline-separated
literal directories or glob patterns (`*`, `**`, `?`). An empty result skips testing.

Each package must commit its npm lockfile and declare test:distribution. That
script runs package-owned contract tests which load process.env.ACTION_ENTRYPOINT.
The shared test action supplies an isolated dist/index.js, clears NODE_PATH and
NODE_OPTIONS, propagates test failures and removes temporary files. Tests may
use development dependencies; the bundle must include its runtime dependencies.

check:dist must rebuild the distribution and reject modified or untracked output.
Dependency lifecycle scripts are disabled during installation. This workflow
never writes commits. Run source tests with the Node.js continuous-integration
workflow, and keep action integration tests and repository security checks in CI.

### Permissions

- **`contents`**: `read`

<!-- overview:end -->
<!-- usage:start -->

## Usage

```yaml
name: Test action distributions
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
permissions: {}
jobs:
  test-action-distributions:
    uses: hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-common/.github/workflows/test-action-distributions.yml@ce885f8dd6bf7191a79e3eebdf37bca805d40932 # 3.0.0
    permissions:
      contents: read
    with:
      # Newline-separated package directories or glob patterns. Empty discovers root and `actions/**` packages declaring build and check:dist scripts.
      working-directories: ""

      # Bundle directory relative to each package, containing index.js.
      # Default: `dist`
      output-directory: dist

      # Node.js version installed for checks on both the host and Node.js 24 container.
      # Default: `24`
      node-version: "24"
```

<!-- usage:end -->
